purpose: Define the non-scored adapter/collector round-trip prerequisite without treating it as detector evidence.

dependency.current_state: No authenticated E1C PASS manifest is present in the workspace; dependency remains waiting.

evidence_sources.role: documented live integration gap and non-scored smoke requirement

allowed_inputs: adapter configuration and versioned normalization contract
forbidden_inputs: FA1B2de playbooks, labels, outcomes, or raw actions
packaged 21D checkpoint or opaque Sample features as live inputs

smoke_protocol.environment: isolated Mininet/controlled-host network with no production connectivity and reversible local state
smoke_protocol.collection: Enable auditd or an equivalent collector using a pinned configuration; capture collector counters, dropped records, timestamps, and raw bytes.
smoke_protocol.trace_content: Benign-only process lifecycle, file read/write, and socket client/server activity; synthetic records may be used to exercise unknown/missing branches.
round_trip: provx-adapted-live-v1 x [N,32] float32 and edge_index [2,E] int64
output envelope containing hashes and reversible raw-key references

release_boundaries.promotion_rule: A future promotion requires a new reviewed manifest proving E1C PASS, fresh non-scored data identity, and the unchanged R5 split/leakage/search contracts; no post-hoc promotion is allowed.

failure_and_stop_conditions: E1C PASS evidence is absent or cannot be authenticated
collector loss exceeds 1% or invalid records exceed 2%
missing process/file/socket coverage without explicit zero/unknown accounting
raw-to-feature hash chain cannot be reproduced
nonfinite tensors, timestamp ordering errors, or unstable IDs occur
any formal benchmark material or APT action appears
any smoke output is used to choose detector architecture, threshold, seed, or formal retry
